title: PIPseq Pipeline - Batch downsample-and-combine workflow
description: Downsamples a batch of already-processed samples' GEX molecule-info and gRNA AnnData to a common depth, and combines them into one AnnData for cross-sample comparison

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

samplesheet.description: CSV describing the batch of samples
samplesheet.help_text: Columns: sample_id, molecule_info_h5, filtered_barcodes_tsv, scrna_metrics_csv, features_tsv, crispr_h5ad. molecule_info_h5/filtered_barcodes_tsv/scrna_metrics_csv are required per row when --run_gex_downsample is true; features_tsv is optional (only needed for a combined GEX+CRISPR molecule_info_h5); crispr_h5ad is required per row when --run_crispr_downsample is true. Any other column is treated as per-sample metadata and carried through into the downsample summary CSVs and the final combined AnnData's .obs.

staged_files.description: Every molecule_info_h5/filtered_barcodes_tsv/scrna_metrics_csv/features_tsv/crispr_h5ad file referenced by --samplesheet, all in one list (not used directly by the pipeline)
staged_files.help_text: Not read directly by the pipeline -- --samplesheet's CSV already references these files by path and is what assigns each one its role. Declaring them here as an input is what makes ICA localize them onto the compute node before the run starts; ICA matches samplesheet path entries to staged files by basename, so which field a file was selected through doesn't matter.

batch_id.help_text: Unique identifier for the batch of samples being processed.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved

downsample_options.title: Downsample options
downsample_options.description: Parameters controlling batch downsampling and combining

run_combine.description: Whether to combine downsampled GEX+gRNA into one AnnData
run_combine.help_text: Requires both --run_gex_downsample and --run_crispr_downsample to be true.

gex_target_depth.description: Override the common GEX target reads/cell
gex_target_depth.help_text: Defaults to the minimum 'Mean reads per cell' observed across the batch when not set.

crispr_target_depth.description: Override the common gRNA target reads/cell
crispr_target_depth.help_text: Defaults to the minimum gRNA mean reads/cell observed across the batch when not set.

run_saturation.description: Also run a GEX sequencing-saturation sweep per sample
run_saturation.help_text: Requires --run_gex_downsample. Writes saturation.csv (median transcripts/genes and % sequencing saturation across a depth ladder) alongside each sample's downsampled GEX matrix.

saturation_extra_depths.description: Extra reads-per-cell depths to include in the saturation sweep, beyond the script's built-in ladder

min_reads_per_cell.description: Floor below which a requested depth is dropped

container_options.title: Container options
container_options.description: Container images used to execute pipeline processes.

qc_container.help_text: Image used by every process in this workflow.

resource_options.title: Resource options
resource_options.description: Resource allocation options for pipeline processes.

cpu_downsample_crispr_anndata.description: Number of CPUs for the DOWNSAMPLE_CRISPR_ANNDATA process

memory_gb_downsample_crispr_anndata.description: Memory in GB for the DOWNSAMPLE_CRISPR_ANNDATA process
